name: open-human-design
description: TD Open Human Design (TD-OHD) — a fork with precise transits, an interactive timeline and three interface languages

scripts.build:pages: npm run build:engine && vite build --mode static
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:engine && vite build --mode desktop
scripts.test:localization: node --test tests/i18n.test.js tests/localization.test.js tests/traditional-chinese.test.js tests/transit-localization.test.js tests/timeline-language-contract.test.js
scripts.test:timeline: node --test tests/line-fixing.test.js tests/timeline-detail-time.test.js tests/timeline-duration.test.js tests/timeline-presets.test.js tests/timeline-ruler.test.js tests/timeline-viewport.test.js tests/transit-timeline.test.js
scripts.e2e:timeline: node tests/timeline-e2e.mjs && node tests/timeline-gestures-e2e.mjs && node tests/timeline-mobile-touch-e2e.mjs && node tests/timeline-mobile-layout-e2e.mjs
